maya: hey @sam @irene — found PII in webhook payloads under s3://redwood-telemetry/webhooks/2026-03-17. need short sudo to run a lambda replay + targeted s3 remove to scrub. requesting just-in-time role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-debug for ~20m
sam: can you paste the exact commands you'll run and the justification? we need to ensure scope is tight
maya: command 1 (lambda invoke):
```
aws lambda invoke --function-name prod-webhook-filter /tmp/out.json --region us-west-2
```
command 2 (delete):
```
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-telemetry/webhooks/2026-03-17/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*session_dump*" --region us-west-2
```
justification: payloads include user emails/tokens accidentally logged by an integration. want to remove only objects matching *session_dump* for that date and replay filtered events into staging for validation. will record session + upload scrub report.
irene: do we have a snapshot/backup of that prefix? please snapshot before delete. i can approve 30m window if ops takes a quick backup and we include session recording and runbook
maya: yes i'm initiating a prefix copy to s3://redwood-telemetry/backups/scrub-2765432100/ now — will not delete until copy completes. will use session name maya-scrub-2765432100 and attach logs
sam: make sure MFA enforced on assumed role and add an explicit condition for resource arn:aws:s3:::redwood-telemetry/webhooks/2026-03-17/* in the temporary creds. once you post the runbook here i'll grant JIT for 20m and monitor
sec-bot: SEC-AUDIT created: ticket SEC-4871 recorded for temp-role request by maya, expires in 20 minutes after grant
alex: small ops note — prefer using `aws s3 cp --recursive` to copy the prefix to backups first; also include ETag verification if possible
maya: copying now (started at 12:14 PDT). copy command: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-telemetry/webhooks/2026-03-17/ s3://redwood-telemetry/backups/scrub-2765432100/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*session_dump*"`
sam: backup looks good based on initial logs. granting JIT for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-debug scoped to that s3 prefix + lambda:InvokeFunction. duration 20m. will post grant token here
sec-bot: GRANT issued: temporary credentials created, session name maya-scrub-2765432100, expires in 20m. audit id SEC-4871
maya: running lambda invoke (will validate filtered output before delete). will post scrub report and object list after run
maya: lambda replay successful, validated filtered output in staging, proceeding to delete matching objects now
maya: delete complete. scrub report uploaded to /hand-offs/scrub-report-2765432100.md and MD5s+object-list posted to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
sam: ack — revoking the temporary creds now and rotating any affected tokens. please confirm no other resources were touched
maya: confirmed only that prefix, no other buckets or lambdas. thanks all
irene: thanks — closing from ops side. leave SEC-4871 for 30d audit retention
sec-bot: AUDIT CLOSED: SEC-4871 marked resolved (retention 30d).
